translations.Sendent Workspace enables administrators: Sendent Workspace enables administrators to create customizable workspaces for different user groups in Nextcloud. Each workspace can contain custom widgets, links, and tools tailored to specific teams or departments, providing a personalized experience for your users. Learn more about Sendent solutions at
translations.Create a library of predefined buttons t: Create a library of predefined buttons that can be used across all workspaces. These buttons will be available to all admins when creating link button widgets.
translations.No buttons in library. Click \"Add New B: No buttons in library. Click "Add New Button" to create your first predefined button.
translations.Manage which groups have access to custo: Manage which groups have access to custom workspaces. Drag groups between lists to activate/deactivate them. The order of active groups determines the priority for users in multiple groups.
translations.This workspace is shown to users who don: This workspace is shown to users who don't belong to any active group.
